subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous set of generic runtime object primitives: linear initializers of small global blocks (0x004B21C0, 0x004B41B0), a family of callback-registration trampolines that pass code addresses into BooleanToIntConversion 0x00587B3E, flag-handler delegation thunks forwarding global addresses to the named sub_4B3DB0, empty-stub invokers, car lighting bitfield manipulators over this+0x2C/0x30 (set/clear by index, 3-bit and 15-bit windows), a three-way float comparator, list containers (a float linked list, an indexed singly-linked list, and a recursive merge-sort over node+0x4 next pointers), global pointer free/teardown helpers through FreeWrapper_7bcf, single-field getters/setters, an audio-mixer-channel init wrapper, a string-key comparator, and vtable dispatchers over the globals dword_8AC4C4 and dword_8AC4C8. All packet owners are UNKNOWN, so every class below is a GUESS grouping anchored on shared field layouts, shared globals, or shared callees; equal offsets on unrelated this pointers are kept separate unless a base expression links them.

summary: Reconstruction of generic runtime objects from 47 validated function IR records. No packet owner is named, so all classes are GUESS-level groupings. The strongest cross-function cluster is the CallbackRegistrationTrampoline family (9 functions), all reading a distinct code/data global and forwarding it to BooleanToIntConversion 0x00587B3E; the second is the car lighting bitfield cluster over this+0x30 (0x004B2AA0/0x004B2AE0/0x004B2B60) plus the separate 0xF00 toggle at this+0x2C (0x004B2A10). Three list containers form a second family: the float linked list (0x004B8150, head/count this+0x6C0/0x6CC), the indexed list (0x004C5130, head/iterator/count/index this+0x8/0x10/0x14/0x18), and the merge sort (0x004C6810, node+0x4 next pointers, SceneSortComparator 0x004C5D30). Two vtable-dispatch pairs operate on the globals dword_8AC4C4 (0x004C8180, 0x004C82F0) and dword_8AC4C8 (0x004C8580, 0x004C85A0), all under null guards. Global-block initializers (0x004B21C0, 0x004B41B0) and global-pointer free helpers (0x004B41D0, 0x004C3040) round out the procedural side. Every function's matched node data, call relationships, and field bases are attributed in function_roles; contradictions (packet-listed fields absent from raw source, ABI names that do not match raw semantics, prelabel getters contradicted by raw bodies) are recorded in unresolved.

function_roles.role: GlobalBlockInitPointerBlock: straight-line initializer that clears dword_83EE60 (0x0083EE60) to zero and points the three adjacent pointer globals dword_8AAE64/8AAE68/8AAE6C at unk_83EE64 (the slot immediately after dword_83EE60), then returns &dword_83EE60. Purpose of the three-pointer block (likely a small cursor or linked-list block whose head is dword_83EE60) is unknown; callers are not evidenced so the init-time vs runtime nature of the reset is unverified.

CallbackRegistrationTrampoline21d0: reads the DebugPrintNullWrapper function pointer at global 0x004B21E0, casts it to int, passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and returns the conversion result. The wrapped routine's behavior and the registration intent (carried only by the LEGACY ABI name) have no callee/field evidence in this packet.

EmptyStubInvoker21e0: single-call void wrapper invoking EmptyStub_0170() with no arguments and no use of its result. The packet's read-evidence global dword_83EE60 is not referenced by this body and is recorded as unresolved (likely an unrelated static fact).

CarFlagBitsToggle: builds a 16-bit selector with high byte (a2+1) and low byte zero, then toggles the 0xF00 bits of the dword at this+0x2C that intersect the selector, storing and returning the result. Prelabel marks it a structural twin of CarFlagByteSetter (0x00476060); caller SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0) is consistent with a car flag/lighting-update role but does not identify the owner object.

LightingBitfieldSetClearByIndex: writes the low bit of a3 into bit position a2 of the 32-bit word at this+0x30 (mask 1<<a2), preserving other bits, and returns the unchanged this pointer. Structural twin of ConditionalSetter0x30 (0x004980C0); bit a2's meaning is caller-supplied (SetupCarLightingAndRender drives it).

LightingBitfieldXorSetter: masked XOR setter for the 3-bit window (bits 28-30, mask 0x70000000) of the word at this+0x30; writes a2's low three bits into the window preserving all other bits, and returns the isolated masked result (old window XOR a2's three low bits). Meaning of the three-bit value is caller-supplied.

LightingBitfieldSetter: writes a2 into the 15-bit window (bits 15-29, mask 0xFFC07FFF) of the word at this+0x30, preserving bits 0-14 and 30-31, and returns the combined value. Whether the surrounding bits carry independent flags is not established here.

FlagHandlerForwardByteFlag: forwards the address of the global byte flag byte_8AB678 (0x008AB678) to the named handler sub_4B3DB0 (absent from the packet callee list, so no address) and returns its result. Shares the byte_8AB678 flag with the EmptyStub family, suggesting a shared flag-guarded callback path; the flag's meaning is unidentified.

CallbackRegistrationTrampoline3d50: reads the code address of the nullsub wrapper at global 0x004B3D60 and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the integer result. No registration state is written in this body; the registration interpretation is ABI-name only (LEGACY).

EmptyStubInvoker3d60: trivial void wrapper invoking EmptyStub_0170() with no arguments and no use of its result. The packet's byte_8AB678 read-evidence is not reachable from this body (it presumably occurs inside the callee stub or reflects an IDB cross-reference) and is recorded as unresolved.

FloatComparator: three-way float comparator returning 1 when *a1 > (double)*a2, 0 when *a1 >= *a2 (covers equality), and -1 otherwise. The first operand is anchored to field this+0x0 per the packet; the second operand *a2 has no field entry. Signature fits a sort/ordering callback but no callers are recorded. The DERIVED getter prelabel conflicts with the raw comparator body; raw source outranks it.

GlobalBlockInitComparisonBlock: linear initializer that calls ArithmeticComparison_9780(&dword_8AB6EC) (callee unaddressed), zeroes the adjacent globals dword_8AB6E4 (0x008AB6E4) and unk_8AB6E8, and returns &dword_8AB6E4. The packet lists dword_8AB6E4 with rw=R although the raw source writes it to 0; the rw classification and the write conflict (unresolved). dword_8AB6EC has no packet global entry.

CallbackRegistrationTrampoline41c0: reads the code address of sub_4B41D0 (global 0x004B41D0) and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the integer result. sub_4B41D0 is referenced only as a code address here; its behavior is outside this packet.

GlobalPointerFreeHierarchy: conditional teardown of the object pointed to by global dword_8AB6EC: when the pointer is non-null, destroys the UI widget hierarchy rooted at it (DestroyUIWidgetHierarchy, unaddressed) and frees the captured pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), returning the free result; the null branch returns an uninitialized local per the decompiler. The packet global entry dword_8AB6E4 is not touched by this body (stale/misaligned entry, unresolved).

FloatLinkedListGetByIndex: returns the float payload at the given index of a linked list whose head is this+0x6C0 and element count this+0x6CC. Guards on index in [0, count), walks next pointers (node+4), dereferences the reached node's first dword as the payload pointer, and returns the -1.0 sentinel (global 0x0059E670 assumed) for an out-of-range index, null node, or null payload. Tail pointer this+0x6C8 is not read here. Sole caller Passthrough (0x004B9D90).

IndirectThis0ForwardThunkGameDataFileIO: dereferences the object's first dword (this+0x0) and forwards it together with a2/a3 to GameDataFileIO, returning the BOOL result. The DERIVED getter prelabel ('returns field 0x0') is contradicted by the raw delegated-call body; raw source wins. Callers sub_4BA1F0 and sub_4BA460 are not available here.

IndirectThis0ForwardDispatchBufferPool: dereferences this+0x0 and passes the loaded pointer to BufferPoolAllocatorInitialization (named only in raw source, unaddressed), returning its result unchanged. No null guard on the dereferenced pointer; single caller sub_4BA460.

TimestepFactorSetter: dereferences this+0x0 to obj, writes a2 into obj+0x9AC, then maps a2 (0-4) onto five float-constant bit patterns at obj+0xF7C (1042983595, 1040187392, 1036831949, 1034594987, 1026206379); an a2 outside 0-4 writes only the index field and returns a2. Timestep interpretation is DERIVED from prior analysis, not confirmed. Single caller sub_4BA460 (0x004BA460).

IndirectThis0ForwardPassthrough: dereferences the object pointer at this+0x0 and forwards the pointed-to object together with a2 to LinkedListFloatAccessor (0x004B8150); returns void. No other reads, writes, guards or state changes. Prelabel marks it a structural twin of 0x00404F70, unconfirmed.

FieldF8CGetter: trivial getter returning the DWORD at this+0xF8C (offset 3980 from the __usercall argument a1). No side effects, guard or callees; the semantic role of field 0xF8C is not grounded in this packet.

DoublePointerAccessor: reads the pointer stored at this+0x8 and returns the DWORD it points to, or 0 when that pointer is null. No side effects. Caller CollisionObjectListManagement (0x004B4B50) suggests list-node usage but that link is not proven by this packet.

NodeDataFree: node-data teardown. Reads the byte flag at this+0xC (returned in every path); when it is non-zero and the primary data pointer at this+0x0 is non-null, frees the secondary pointer at obj+0x4 first (if non-null), then the primary block, both via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Never frees the node buffer itself (unlike structural twin 0x004BA900), which the caller GameDataFileIO may own. Data-block layout (primary/secondary) is unknown.

TwoFieldZeroInit: writes 0 to this[12] (offset 0x30) and this[41] (offset 0xA4) and returns 0. Reached from VehgenScnFileLoader (0x004C6C40), so the target object is created/initialized along the vehicle-gen scene-file load path; the owning class and the purpose of the two zeroed fields are unknown.

StateFieldToOne: unconditional setter writing the literal 1 to the state/mode field this+0x60 (element this[24]). No parameters beyond this, no guards, no callees, no return value. The state semantics of the value 1 (which state machine, which enum) are not grounded in this packet.

AudioMixerChannelInitWrapper: single-function-call wrapper passing the audio mixer channel state in global dword_8AB710 (0x008AB710) to the callee named AudioMixerChannelInit (no packet address) and returning that callee's result. No local computation; the type/layout of dword_8AB710 is unknown.

CallbackRegistrationTrampolineUnregister: casts the address of the data global unk_4BD7C0 (0x004BD7C0) to int and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the result. The ABI-name callback-unregistration intent is unverified; the body shows only a read path and no callers are recorded.

CounterIncrement: bumps the 32-bit field at this+0x34 (this[13]) by one in place and returns void; invoked by sub_4A0760 (0x004A0760). The packet classifies field 0x34 as read-only (rw=R) although the raw source performs an in-place read-modify-write, and the prelabel labels it a no-side-effect getter; both are contradicted by the raw source, which outranks them.

FlagHandlerDelegation2fa0: forwards the address of the untyped global unk_8AC388 (0x008AC388) to the named handler sub_4B3DB0 (absent from the packet callee list) and returns its result. The callee's behavior and the global's content are unknown.

CallbackRegistrationTrampoline2fb0: casts the address of sub_4C2FC0 (global 0x004C2FC0) to int and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the result. No callers recorded; the purpose of passing a code address into a boolean-to-int helper is unknown.

CallbackRegistrationTrampoline2ff0: reads the callback address at global 0x004C3000 (R) and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the conversion result. No unresolved items remain in the packet.

GlobalComparisonForward: reads the global dword at 0x008AC36C and forwards it as the single argument to the named callee ArithmeticComparison_4930 (no packet address), returning that int result unchanged. The meaning of the compared quantity and the comparison semantics are not recoverable from this function alone.

FlagHandlerDelegation3020: forwards the address of the untyped global unk_8AC368 (0x008AC368) as the single argument to the named handler sub_4B3DB0 and returns its void* result verbatim. Matches the LEGACY ABI label Delegation_Thunk_4c3020; why it is a delegation thunk rather than a plain call is not determinable here.

CallbackRegistrationTrampoline3030: reads the callback address at global 0x004C3040 (R) and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the conversion result. No unresolved items remain in the packet.

GlobalPointerFreeClear: if the global pointer dword_8AC490 is non-zero, frees it through FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) and clears the global to null, returning the free result; otherwise returns the stored value. The packet global entry 0x008AC368 does not appear in this raw source (address discrepancy unresolved); purpose of the allocation behind dword_8AC490 is unknown.

StringKeyComparator: derives a comparison key from the object at offset 116 on each side via sub_587ECE (0x00587ECE) and returns whether the calling object's derived key is strictly less than the other object's key, as a BOOL. Offset 116 is a dword index per the Hex-Rays rendering; the key-derivation helper's semantics are unknown. Caller context (VehicleDataLoader, 0x004C4240) suggests a vehicle-data string comparison but no object type evidence exists.

IndexedListAccessor: returns the data value at position index (this+0x18) of a singly linked list whose head is this+0x8 and count this+0x14. In-range access walks the list to the indexed node and returns the value pointed to by the node's first dword; out-of-range access resets the iterator this+0x10 to the head and returns the first element's value (or 0 when the list is empty). Node payload type unconfirmed; caller TrackSceneConfigLoader (0x00477680) is external context.

LinkedListMergeSort: top-down merge sort for a singly-linked list whose next pointers are at node+0x4. Counts nodes, recursively sorts both halves after a midpoint split (terminating the left half by zeroing the midpoint's next), and merges the halves using SceneSortComparator (0x004C5D30) ordering. Returns the new head, or the input unchanged for null or short lists. Caller SceneFileFilterBuilder (0x004C6330) suggests scene-filter list use (DERIVED).

GlobalRegionZeroInit: one-call wrapper that zero-initializes four consecutive dwords at the global flt_8AC4B0 (0x008AC4B0) via the named helper ZeroInit4Ints (no packet address) and returns the resulting pointer. Whether flt_8AC4B0 is an actual float value or a reinterpreted dword region is unknown.

CallbackRegistrationTrampolineUnregister2: reads the PhysicsVectorGetter callback address at global 0x004C7C50 (R) and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the conversion result. No unresolved items remain in the packet.

GlobalListContainerReset: resets the global container/list object at byte_8AC494 (0x008AC494) by writing 0 into seven consecutive dwords (byte_8AC494 through unk_8AC4A8) and the literal 1120403456 into unk_8AC4AC, then returns the container base pointer. The first write clears the container head pointer; the trailing literal's meaning (e.g. a float bit pattern) is not provable from this packet alone. Sister 0x004C7C90 destroys the same object.

CallbackRegistrationTrampoline7c80: casts the address of the stub sub_4C7C90 (global 0x004C7C90) to int and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the result. The ABI name Free_Callback_Registration_4c7c80 is not corroborated by packet evidence.

GlobalListContainerDestroy: destroys the global container/list object at byte_8AC494 (0x008AC494) by calling ListDestructorWithSubFree on it (callee unaddressed) and returns that call's integer result. Forms the reset/destroy pair with 0x004C7C70 for the byte_8AC494 container; element type unknown.

FieldFourZero: writes 0 into the DWORD field at offset +0x4 of the receiver object (this[1]) unconditionally; used as a state/reset flag clear during an audio restart sequence (caller Sound_Restart 0x004C8B20). The receiver class and whether +0x4 is genuinely a sound-related state flag are not established from this packet.

GlobalVTableDispatchSlot40: when the global object pointer dword_8AC4C4 (0x008AC4C4) is non-null, dispatches an indirect __thiscall through vtable offset +40 (slot index 10) passing (dword_8AC4C4, 0, 0, 0) and returns its result; the null path returns an uninitialized local per the decompiler. Invoked from sub_4A0250 (0x004A0250) and Sound_Post (0x004C8CA0). Object type and slot meaning unknown.

GlobalVTableDispatchCameraView: when dword_8AC4C4 is non-null, calls the vtable method at offset 56 with argument 2 and the vtable method at offset 4 with hWnd (global 0x007CE2DC); a non-zero offset-4 return clears dword_8AC4C4 to null, otherwise the vtable methods at offsets 44 (argument 1065353216) and 52 (argument dword_7CF230) are called. Legacy ABI label Camera_View_System_Dispatch is uncorroborated; the only static caller is Sound_Enter (0x004C8A20). Method argument meanings unknown.

GlobalVTableQueryGuard: boolean predicate returning true only when dword_8AC4C8 (0x008AC4C8) is non-null and the indirect __thiscall through its vtable offset +8 (slot index 2, this = dword_8AC4C8) returns non-zero. Consumed by FileLoadWithRetryLoop (0x004F9B70) where it appears to gate a follow-up action. The +8 slot's query role is inferred from its boolean use.

GlobalVTableDispatchQueryAction: two-stage guarded virtual dispatch on dword_8AC4C8: when the object pointer is non-null, calls the vtable offset +8 __thiscall (this = dword_8AC4C8) as a query; if that returns non-zero, invokes the vtable offset +16 __thiscall (slot index 4) as the action. Paired with VTableMethodGuard (0x004C8580) on the same object; consumed by FileLoadWithRetryLoop (0x004F9B70).

classes.name: GlobalBlockInitializer
classes.responsibility: Procedural linear initializers (no instance fields) that reset a small contiguous global block and hand its base address to the caller: 0x004B21C0 clears dword_83EE60 and points three adjacent pointer globals at unk_83EE64; 0x004B41B0 calls ArithmeticComparison_9780(&dword_8AB6EC) and zeroes dword_8AB6E4/unk_8AB6E8. The two blocks are unrelated globals grouped only by the identical init-return pattern.

classes.name: CallbackRegistrationTrampoline
classes.responsibility: Family of single-call wrappers (9 functions) that read a code address or data-global address from a distinct global slot, cast it to int, and pass it as the single argument to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), returning the conversion result. None writes registration state; the register/unregister interpretation rests on the LEGACY ABI names only. Each trampoline reads its own global slot (0x004B21E0, 0x004B3D60, 0x004B41D0, 0x004BD7C0, 0x004C2FC0, 0x004C3000, 0x004C3040, 0x004C7C50, 0x004C7C90).

classes.name: EmptyStubInvoker
classes.responsibility: Trivial void wrappers (2 functions) that invoke the named stub EmptyStub_0170 with no arguments and no use of its result. EmptyStub_0170 has no callee evidence in the packet; each wrapper carries an unrelated packet read-evidence global (0x0083EE60 / 0x008AB678) that its body never touches.

classes.name: CarFlagFieldOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a 32-bit flag/lighting word at this+0x2C whose 0xF00 bits are toggled by 0x004B2A10 with a (a2+1)<<8 selector. Structural twin of CarFlagByteSetter (0x00476060) per the prelabel; driven by SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0). The semantics of the 0xF00 bits are unknown.

classes.name: LightingBitfieldOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a 32-bit bitfield word at this+0x30 manipulated by three methods: single-bit set/clear by index (1<<a2, 0x004B2AA0), a 3-bit window in bits 28-30 set by masked XOR (mask 0x70000000, 0x004B2AE0), and a 15-bit window in bits 15-29 set with mask 0xFFC07FFF (0x004B2B60). All three are driven by SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0); the meaning of each window is caller-supplied and unknown.

The first operand is anchored to this+0x0; the second operand has no packet field entry. Signature fits a sort/ordering callback but no callers are recorded.

The null branches differ (uninitialized local vs stored value).
